subject.title: fix(chat): preserve PNG attachments in native clients

question: Should native clients preserve every selected PNG as bounded PNG output, preserve only alpha-bearing PNGs, or retain the existing bounded-JPEG normalization policy?
rationale: All three choices are technically viable but trade format fidelity and transparency against payload size, downscaling, consistency, and the deliberately established JPEG behavior; source review cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Preserve bounded PNGs
options.body: Keep this branch's uniform policy for all PNG inputs, subject to real-device gateway proof for the three changed native paths.

options.title: Preserve alpha PNGs only
options.body: Detect transparency and keep PNG only when JPEG would destroy visible alpha, retaining JPEG normalization for opaque PNGs.

options.title: Retain JPEG normalization
options.body: Keep the existing shipped policy and close or substantially narrow this PR if bounded consistency is preferred over source-format fidelity.

recommendation.title: Preserve bounded PNGs
recommendation.body: Keep this branch's uniform policy for all PNG inputs, subject to real-device gateway proof for the three changed native paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a user-visible cross-native product policy rather than a mechanical correctness choice, and the repository owner was explicitly routed into the current discussion.
